blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08 across all six deterministic-address ERC-1967 deployments. Ethereum block 25712393, Base 49714331, Worldchain 33441185, BSC 114794465, Polygon 91675323, and Gnosis 47624683 all resolve implementation slot 0xfbab5dcb1647787ec8402a6509add256fa6c7f9d and paused() false; Ripio EOA 0x466c02e2cc67b81a696af5afdb61605c41fe247b holds PAUSER_ROLE on every deployment. Both verified LatamStable revisions route _update through ERC20PausableUpgradeable, so this EOA can halt every holder transfer. The Polygon/BSC/Gnosis revision additionally exposes COMPLIANCE_ROLE-gated blockUser/unblockUser and checks blocked senders and recipients when enforcement is enabled. A live global pause alone is a direct holder restriction and resolves the access verdict to Yes; the compliance-bearing deployments add holder-selective reach.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ripio issues wBRL natively on Ethereum, Base, World Chain, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis: every deployment is an EIP-1167 clone of one Ripio master implementation, and per-chain MINTER_ROLE is held only by Ripio-administered accounts (mint-authority review 2026-06-11, role reads re-verified for this review). No third-party bridge carries the representation.
